_comment: ✏️ EDIT YOUR CARD PAGE HERE — this controls everything on kaylacarabes.com/card. Change the name, tagline, location, photos, or the banner painting, and add/remove/reorder the link buttons. The 'Save my contact' + 'Add to Apple Wallet' buttons live in card/index.html.
name: Kayla Carabes
_imagesHelp: Paths start from your site root. 'featured' is the big banner painting at the top, 'photo' is the round portrait, 'logo' is the small mark in the banner corner.
_linksHelp: Each link needs a "label" (the text people see) and a "url". Add "external": true for links that leave your site so they open in a new tab. Add "sublabel": "..." for a small second line. Add "highlight": true to make it a big, warm, eye-catching card with a pulsing 'live' dot — great for a limited-time thing like an auction. Delete the card when it's over.
